result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: overlapping, unreadable text in the delivery info line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery info line is garbled with overlapping text — '25-30 min delivery • Ramen' has another word rendered on top of it around '25-3...delivery', making the text illegible.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate/overlapping text layer and ensure only a single delivery-info string is rendered in that line with proper spacing and no absolute-position collision.
